value.product_line: socks (crew, merino wool, no-show, cushioned lines)
value.issue: The most repeated complaint across sock lines: a hole develops in the heel within weeks to a few months of normal wear, sometimes after the first wash.

text: The most repeated complaint across sock lines: a hole develops in the heel within weeks to a few months of normal wear, sometimes after the first wash.

evidence.quote: Absolutely one of the worst customer experiences I have had in 40 years...after just 2 wears I had a hole in the heal of 1 pair.
3 months later 2 of them were worn out with holes on the heels.
Every sock I've ever had from Bombas has gotten a hole in the heel

Didn't even last the season. I bought these and only wore them 7 or 8 times before a hole started to develop in the heel. Always washed on cold and hang-dried. After their first wash they were already shedding badly.

notes: Rough share from a sample of 47 public review quotes (mostly Trustpilot, some Nordstrom, Sitejabber and one Good Housekeeping consumer test), which skews toward complaints since review sites over index unhappy customers. Not measured against the full customer base. Reddit could not be reached from this session, so no forum quotes are included.

value.issue: No-show and cushioned no-show socks are reported to slip down or ride off the heel during wear, after fitting well when first tried on.
